ltd.total_expense), 2) AS avg_net_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ltd.num_loans > 0 THEN cws.client_id END) AS customers_with_loans, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ltd.num_loans > 0 THEN cws.client_id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT cws.client_id), 2) AS percent_with_loans FROM CustomerWeeklyStatements AS cws JOIN ClientInfo AS ci ON cws.client_id = ci.client_id JOIN LoanAndTransactionData AS ltd ON cws.client_id = ltd.client_id GROUP BY ci.gender, ci.age_group, ci.region ORDER BY total_weekly_owners DESC
